{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfyffA8FS52b57VeSNVSz","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01WnQPVjK4JFSqq4UY8rxkzM","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20261012-111947/nbody_claude-haiku-5.5-cc-medium_hybrid_r2/nbody/nbody.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\nconstexpr double SOFTENING = 1e-9;\nconstexpr double DT = 0.01;\nconstexpr int THREADS_PER_BLOCK = 256;\n\nstruct Vec3 {\n    double x, y, z;\n    __host__ __device__ constexpr Vec3(const double x = 0, const double y = 0, const double z = 0) noexcept : x(x), y(y), z(z) {}\n};\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                        \\\n    do {                                                                                        \\\n        const cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                                        \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                                              \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error at %s:%d: %s\\n\", __FILE__, __LINE__, cudaGetErrorString(err_)); \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                       \\\n        }                                                                                       \\\n    } while (0)\n\nvoid randomizeBodies(std::vector<Vec3>& pos, std::vector<Vec3>& vel, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < pos.size(); ++i) {\n        pos[i].x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        pos[i].y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        pos[i].z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].x = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].y = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        vel[i].z = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n    }\n}\n\n// One thread per body in [firstBody, firstBody + count). Each thread accumulates over all n bodies\n// in index order, exactly as the serial loop did. Source positions are staged through shared memory.\n__global__ void computeForcesKernel(const Vec3* __restrict__ pos, Vec3* __restrict__ vel,\n                                    int firstBody, int count, int n) {\n    __shared__ Vec3 tile[THREADS_PER_BLOCK];\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    const bool active = li < count;\n    const Vec3 pi = active ? pos[firstBody + li] : Vec3();\n    double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n    for (int base = 0; base < n; base += THREADS_PER_BLOCK) {\n        const int j = base + threadIdx.x;\n        if (j < n) tile[threadIdx.x] = pos[j];\n        __syncthreads();\n\n        const int tileCount = (n - base < THREADS_PER_BLOCK) ? n - base : THREADS_PER_BLOCK;\n        for (int k = 0; k < tileCount; ++k) {\n            const Vec3 pj = tile[k];\n            const double dx = pj.x - pi.x;\n            const double dy = pj.y - pi.y;\n            const double dz = pj.z - pi.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    if (active) {\n        vel[li].x += DT * Fx;\n        vel[li].y += DT * Fy;\n        vel[li].z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n__global__ void integrateKernel(Vec3* __restrict__ pos, const Vec3* __restrict__ vel, int firstBody, int count) {\n    const int li = blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (li >= count) return;\n    Vec3& p = pos[firstBody + li];\n    const Vec3 v = vel[li];\n    p.x += v.x * DT;\n    p.y += v.y * DT;\n    p.z += v.z * DT;\n}\n\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const std::vector<Vec3>& pos, const std::vector<Vec3>& vel) {\n    double energy = 0.0;\n    const size_t n = pos.size();\n\n    // Kinetic energy (assuming unit mass)\n    for (const auto& v : vel) {\n        energy += 0.5 * (v.x * v.x + v.y * v.y + v.z * v.z);\n    }\n\n    // Potential energy (assuming unit mass for all bodies). Each row i is independent, so rows are\n    // summed in parallel and then accumulated in index order.\n    std::vector<double> rowPotential(n, 0.0);\n    #pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        double row = 0.0;\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = pos[j].x - pos[i].x;\n            const double dy = bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (identical on every rank)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0)       const long long end = static_cast<long long>(n) * (r + 1) / size;\n        displs[r] = static_cast<int>(begin);\n        counts[r] = static_cast<int>(end - begin);\n    }\n    const int rankLo = MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &nodeComm);\n    int nodeRank = 0, nodeSize = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(nodeComm, &nodeRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(nodeComm, &nodeSize);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&nodeComm);\n\n    int numDevices = 0;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetDeviceCount(&numDevices));\n    std::vector<int> devices;\n    for (int d = nodeRank; d < numDevices; d += nodeSize) {\n        devices.push_back(d);\n    }\n    if (devices.empty()) {\n        fprintf(stderr, \"Rank %d has no GPU: %d GPUs on node, %d ranks on node\\n\", rank, numDevices, nodeSize);\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011CfygGFGJ5GFT8Ju6hXtsn","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The nbody benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. It builds from `nbody/` with the same `nbody` executable name, and only `nbody/nbody.cpp` and `nbody/CMakeLists.txt` changed. The build is warning-free with `-Wall -Wextra`. I built and tested it in `/tmp` so the project directory has no build artifacts. This is not a git repo, so I did not commit.\n\n**Design**\n- **MPI** splits the bodies into contiguous blocks, one per rank. Each step does an `MPI_Allgatherv` of positions. The initial state is generated identically on every rank, so no initial scatter is needed.\n- **CUDA** runs one thread per body in a shared-memory tiled force kernel. Each body still sums over j = 0..N-1 in order, as the original loop does. A second kernel integrates positions.\n- **OpenMP** has one thread per GPU. Each rank's node-local GPUs are assigned round-robin by node-local rank. OpenMP also parallelizes the O(N²) energy diagnostic.\n- **Unconditional**: MPI (with `MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED`), OpenMP, and CUDA are all `REQUIRED` in CMake. There is no CPU fallback. A rank with no GPU aborts.\n\n**Verification**\n- Output is identical across 1, 2, and 4 ranks, and across different GPU counts per rank.\n- Results agree with the original to about 1e-11 relative. The energy matches to about 2e-14. The `-r` hash is not bit-identical to the original's. I believe the cause is FMA contraction and device arithmetic differences, but I did not verify that, because I had overwritten the original source.\n- Edge cases work: `-n 0`, `-n 1`, `-s 0`, `-h`, and an unknown option.\n\n**Performance** (4× RTX 3090, 20 steps)\n- N=65536: 2.4 s on one GPU and about 0.67 s on four (about 3.6×).\n- N=32768: 1.3 s with 256-thread blocks, now about 0.72 s with 64-thread blocks. Smaller blocks fill the SMs better when each GPU has few bodies.\n- Timings were noisy on this shared machine, so treat these numbers as approximate.\n\n**Choices you may want to change**\n- Architectures default to `70;80;86;90`. Override with `-DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES=...`.\n- The energy potential sums each row in parallel and then accumulates the rows in order. The printed energy differs only in the last digits.\n- Requires CMake ≥ 3.24, CUDA ≥ 12, and an MPI library that supports `MPI_THREAD_FUNNELED`."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1037,"cache_read_input_tokens":77248,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1037},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"0d8bde1c-b4fc-4265-9ba2-a36049b87efa","uuid":"ac0e7652-8ee6-4a5f-82e6-f16fa261611b","timestamp":"2026-10-13T05:23:39.656Z","request_id":"req_011CfygGEwwAkGQxMme5mmKq"}
